mapper.update: update attach_executor_command set status = #{status}, result_json = #{resultJson}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, finished_at = #{finishedAt}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} where id = #{id}
mapper.select: update attach_executor_command set status = 'LEASED', attempt = attempt + 1, lease_owner = #{actor}, lease_expires_at = #{leaseExpiresAt}, started_at = coalesce(started_at, #{now}), updated_at = #{now} where id = ( select id from attach_executor_command where executor_id = #{executorId} and ( status = 'PENDING' or (status = 'LEASED' and lease_expires_at < #{now}) ) and attempt < max_attempts order by created_at, id for update skip locked limit 1 ) returning *
mapper.update: update instance set status = case when environment_id is null then 'PENDING_ASSIGNMENT' else 'ACTIVE' end, last_seen_at = #{lastSeenAt}, lease_expires_at = #{leaseExpiresAt}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} where id in ( select instance_id from attach_executor_target where executor_id = #{executorId} and status in ('ACTIVE', 'ONLINE') )
